body.message:
Hello,
Thank you for your message.
Yes, I am open to listing my apartment as a holiday home for short-term rental.
It is a 2-bedroom apartment in Regalia by Deyaar, Business Bay. Could you please provide me with an estimated net monthly return, after deducting all charges and management fees?
I would also appreciate it if you could share the expected occupancy rate, average nightly rate, service charges, DTCM fees, management fees, and any other costs involved.
Best regards,
Mounir
